tool_args.rationale: The paid observations include the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature, with alternating large positive and negative responses. Abstain rather than claim a reliable stationary law.

considered_alternatives.option: Weibull, Avrami, or Richards stationary smooth models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation, so a stationary smooth mechanism is not justified.
The reported oscillation signature already triggers scoped abstention; another measurement is not needed for that decision.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
